plan_truth.legacy_teams_note: Existing Canva Teams subscribers can continue on their existing Teams plan; new team sign-ups/upgrades use Canva Business.
plan_truth.team_workspace_note: Designs created inside a team workspace stay in that team workspace; a removed member can lose access to those team designs.

account_policy.risk_summary: Midjourney says only one user may use a registered account and users may not resell or redistribute the Services or access to the Service, including sharing an account. Shared access therefore carries explicit provider-policy and suspension/ban risk.

midjourney.commercial_use_note: General commercial terms apply to subscribed users, but a company with more than US$1,000,000 in annual gross revenue must use Pro or Mega for company commercial use.
